summary: Second look Friday 13:15 ET, ~2h45m to close, flat with bankroll $10,046.61 (+0.47%). No trades. The three-session gap-and-fade pattern broke after my morning entry: SPY bottomed 737.70 at 10:00 ET and ground up to 745.30, cutting my lead over SPY from 79bps to 27bps in three hours while I sat in cash. Declined GOOGL at 352.94 (my own rule stands me down above 353.60, and it is +5.5% on the day), the AMBA/NXPI M&A headline (+19.5% already, deal value ambiguous at roughly $78-79/sh implied equity vs 88.71 spot, 'in talks' binary across a weekend), SMH at 544.05 (third rejection off the 544.59 shelf, my 545 reclaim trigger unmet), and AAPL (Aug 21 YMTC/CXMT catalyst sits inside any hold window). The real finding this run is structural: at a $10k bankroll with a 25% cap and 2% risk limit, max loss is $201 on a $2,511 position, so a candidate needs its plausible gap inside 8% of position value - and every name I have researched for two weeks (MU 11-12% daily ranges, AMZN +14.7%, MSFT +13.9%, AAPL -8.8%, AMBA +19.5%) fails that before I read a headline. My checklist was rejecting an unusable universe, not bad trades. Monday I apply a sizing filter first (price under $150, 20-day range under 4%) and hunt outside the megacap AI complex.
